lines.raw: In the US, this idea is written into law.
lines.say: In the U S, this idea is written into law.

lines.raw: The most important law about patient information is called **HIPAA**.
lines.say: The most important law about patient information is called HIPAA.

lines.raw: If you work with US healthcare data, even from an office in Nepal, HIPAA will shape almost everything you do.
lines.say: If you work with U S healthcare data, even from an office in Nepal, HIPAA will shape almost everything you do.

scenes.section: Start with something you already know

lines.raw: Simple definition.
lines.say: Simple definition.

lines.raw: HIPAA is a US federal law that says who may see, use and share a patient's health information, how that information must be protected, and what must happen when it leaks.
lines.say: HIPAA is a U S federal law that says who may see, use and share a patient's health information, how that information must be protected, and what must happen when it leaks.

lines.raw: It also set the standard formats US insurers and hospitals use to exchange data.
lines.say: It also set the standard formats U S insurers and hospitals use to exchange data.

lines.raw: Meet our people.
lines.say: Meet our people.

lines.raw: This course uses a few made-up people as examples.
lines.say: This course uses a few made-up people as examples.

lines.raw: In Kathmandu, **Ram** works at a tech startup that buys him private health insurance, and **Sita** is an accountant who uses SSF-listed hospitals through the **Social Security Fund (SSF)**.
lines.say: In Kathmandu, Ram works at a tech startup that buys him private health insurance, and Sita is an accountant who uses S S F listed hospitals through the Social Security Fund (S S F).

lines.raw: In Austin, Texas, **Emily Carter** is covered by her employer's health plan (insurer member ID `M1001`), together with her daughter **Lily**.
lines.say: In Austin, Texas, Emily Carter is covered by her employer's health plan (insurer member I D M 1 0 0 1), together with her daughter Lily.

lines.raw: In 2025 she saw her family doctor, **Dr. Patel**, for strep throat on 10 March (claim `23098908`), and in June she had her appendix removed at **Lakeside General Hospital**.
lines.say: In 2025 she saw her family doctor, Doctor Patel, for strep throat on 10 March (claim 2 3 0 9 8 9 0 8), and in June she had her appendix removed at Lakeside General Hospital.

lines.raw: The name.
lines.say: The name.

lines.raw: What the letters mean.
lines.say: What the letters mean.

lines.raw: H: Health.
lines.say: H: Health.

lines.raw: I: Insurance.
lines.say: I: Insurance.

lines.raw: P: Portability (taking your coverage with you).
lines.say: P: Portability (taking your coverage with you).

lines.raw: A: and.
lines.say: A: and.

lines.raw: A: Accountability.
lines.say: A: Accountability.

lines.raw: Common spelling mistake.
lines.say: Common spelling mistake.

lines.raw: It is **HIPAA** (one P, two A's), not "HIPPA".
lines.say: It is HIPAA (one P, two A's), not "H I P P A".

lines.raw: Notice there is no "Privacy" in the name.
lines.say: Notice there is no "Privacy" in the name.

lines.raw: The privacy rules came later, under one part of the law.
lines.say: The privacy rules came later, under one part of the law.

lines.raw: HIPAA became law in **August 1996**.
lines.say: HIPAA became law in August 1996.

lines.raw: Its first goal was **portability**: helping workers keep health coverage when they changed or lost a job.
lines.say: Its first goal was portability: helping workers keep health coverage when they changed or lost a job.

lines.raw: Another part, called **Administrative Simplification**, told the US Department of Health and Human Services (**HHS**) to create national standards for healthcare data.
lines.say: Another part, called Administrative Simplification, told the U S Department of Health and Human Services (H H S) to create national standards for healthcare data.

lines.raw: The famous privacy and security rules grew out of that part.
lines.say: The famous privacy and security rules grew out of that part.

lines.raw: The main rules under HIPAA.
lines.say: The main rules under HIPAA.

lines.raw: Here is a quick table.
lines.say: Here is a quick table.

lines.raw: **Privacy Rule**. In one sentence: Who may use or share health information, and what rights patients have. In effect from (roughly): 2003.
lines.say: Privacy Rule. In one sentence: Who may use or share health information, and what rights patients have. In effect from (roughly): 2003.

lines.raw: **Security Rule**. In one sentence: How **electronic** health information must be protected. In effect from (roughly): 2005.
lines.say: Security Rule. In one sentence: How electronic health information must be protected. In effect from (roughly): 2005.

lines.raw: **Breach Notification Rule**. In one sentence: Who must be told, and how fast, when health information leaks. In effect from (roughly): 2009 (added by a later law called HITECH).
lines.say: Breach Notification Rule. In one sentence: Who must be told, and how fast, when health information leaks. In effect from (roughly): 2009 (added by a later law called HITECH).

lines.raw: **Transactions and Code Sets**. In one sentence: The standard electronic formats and codes for claims, eligibility and payments. In effect from (roughly): Early 2000s.
lines.say: Transactions and Code Sets. In one sentence: The standard electronic formats and codes for claims, eligibility and payments. In effect from (roughly): Early 2000s.

lines.raw: **Enforcement Rule**. In one sentence: How violations are investigated and fined. In effect from (roughly): 2006.
lines.say: Enforcement Rule. In one sentence: How violations are investigated and fined. In effect from (roughly): 2006.

lines.raw: Who enforces it?
lines.say: Who enforces it?

lines.raw: The **Office for Civil Rights (OCR)**, part of HHS, investigates complaints and breaches and can fine organisations.
lines.say: The Office for Civil Rights (O C R), part of H H S, investigates complaints and breaches and can fine organisations.

lines.raw: Serious, deliberate misuse can also become a **criminal** case handled by the US Department of Justice.
lines.say: Serious, deliberate misuse can also become a criminal case handled by the U S Department of Justice.

lines.raw: The part data people forget: standard formats and codes.
lines.say: The part data people forget: standard formats and codes.

scenes.section: The part data people forget: standard formats and codes

lines.raw: Before HIPAA, every insurer had its own claim format.
lines.say: Before HIPAA, every insurer had its own claim format.

lines.raw: HIPAA fixed this by naming **one standard electronic format** for each common exchange (claims, payments, eligibility checks and more), the official **code sets** for diagnoses, services and drugs, and the **NPI** (National Provider Identifier), the ID number every provider puts on a claim.
lines.say: HIPAA fixed this by naming one standard electronic format for each common exchange (claims, payments, eligibility checks and more), the official code sets for diagnoses, services and drugs, and the N P I (National Provider Identifier), the I D number every provider puts on a claim.

lines.raw: This course is about the privacy side; the formats themselves are taught in the Interoperability course.
lines.say: This course is about the privacy side; the formats themselves are taught in the Interoperability course.

scenes.section: The part data people forget: standard formats and codes

lines.raw: Why this matters for data work.
lines.say: Why this matters for data work.

lines.raw: When someone says "HIPAA" at work, they usually mean **privacy**.
lines.say: When someone says "HIPAA" at work, they usually mean privacy.

lines.raw: But every claim file, every diagnosis code and every provider ID you load into a table exists because of the same law.
lines.say: But every claim file, every diagnosis code and every provider I D you load into a table exists because of the same law.

scenes.section: The part data people forget: standard formats and codes

lines.raw: Extra-sensitive records.
lines.say: Extra-sensitive records.

lines.raw: Records from substance use disorder treatment programs have an even stricter US rule on top of HIPAA, called **42 CFR Part 2**.
lines.say: Records from substance use disorder treatment programs have an even stricter U S rule on top of HIPAA, called 42 C F R Part 2.

lines.raw: It is covered in the Behavioral Health course; for now, just know that some data has tighter limits than ordinary PHI.
lines.say: It is covered in the Behavioral Health course; for now, just know that some data has tighter limits than ordinary P H I.

scenes.section: Nepal and the US side by side

lines.raw: Patient confidentiality in Nepal.
lines.say: Patient confidentiality in Nepal.

lines.raw: With private insurance:
lines.say: With private insurance:

lines.raw: Doctors in Nepal are expected by their professional code of ethics to keep what patients tell them **confidential**.
lines.say: Doctors in Nepal are expected by their professional code of ethics to keep what patients tell them confidential.

lines.raw: Nepal's **Constitution (2015)** recognises a right to privacy, and the **Individual Privacy Act, 2075 (2018)** treats health information as personal information that should not be shared without consent, with some exceptions.
lines.say: Nepal's Constitution (2015) recognises a right to privacy, and the Individual Privacy Act, 2075 (2018) treats health information as personal information that should not be shared without consent, with some exceptions.

lines.raw: When Ram sends his hospital bills to his private insurer for reimbursement, he hands over his diagnosis.
lines.say: When Ram sends his hospital bills to his private insurer for reimbursement, he hands over his diagnosis.

lines.raw: He trusts the insurer to keep it private, but there are few detailed rules telling the insurer exactly how.
lines.say: He trusts the insurer to keep it private, but there are few detailed rules telling the insurer exactly how.

lines.raw: With the Social Security Fund:
lines.say: With the Social Security Fund:

lines.raw: When Sita uses an SSF-listed hospital, the hospital shares her diagnosis and bill with SSF so it can pay its 80%.
lines.say: When Sita uses an S S F listed hospital, the hospital shares her diagnosis and bill with S S F so it can pay its 80 percent.

lines.raw: That sharing is needed for **payment**.
lines.say: That sharing is needed for payment.

lines.raw: Nepal does not (as of this writing) have one detailed health-data law like HIPAA, with its long list of technical safeguards, breach deadlines and fines.
lines.say: Nepal does not (as of this writing) have one detailed health-data law like HIPAA, with its long list of technical safeguards, breach deadlines and fines.

lines.raw: Rules exist, but they are more general.
lines.say: Rules exist, but they are more general.

scenes.section: Nepal and the US side by side

lines.raw: In the US: Emily in Texas.
lines.say: In the U S: Emily in Texas.

lines.raw: When Emily sees Dr. Patel for strep throat, HIPAA decides who may see her diagnosis `J02.0`: Dr. Patel's clinic, her insurer, and the companies they hire to process claims.
lines.say: When Emily sees Doctor Patel for strep throat, HIPAA decides who may see her diagnosis J 0 2 . 0: Doctor Patel's clinic, her insurer, and the companies they hire to process claims.

lines.raw: Her employer, Bluebonnet Logistics, may **not** see her diagnosis just because it sponsors the plan.
lines.say: Her employer, Bluebonnet Logistics, may not see her diagnosis just because it sponsors the plan.

lines.raw: If Emily's claim data leaks, the insurer must tell her in writing, and may face fines.
lines.say: If Emily's claim data leaks, the insurer must tell her in writing, and may face fines.

lines.raw: Her claim travels in a standard electronic format, with standard diagnosis and service codes and Dr. Patel's **NPI**: all HIPAA standards.
lines.say: Her claim travels in a standard electronic format, with standard diagnosis and service codes and Doctor Patel's N P I: all HIPAA standards.

scenes.section: Nepal and the US side by side

lines.raw: HIPAA applies to you, even in Kathmandu.
lines.say: HIPAA applies to you, even in Kathmandu.

lines.raw: Many Nepali companies process US claims, code medical records or build data pipelines for US clients.
lines.say: Many Nepali companies process U S claims, code medical records or build data pipelines for U S clients.

lines.raw: HIPAA is a US law, but your US client will make your company sign a contract promising to follow it (you will learn about this **BAA** in the next lesson).
lines.say: HIPAA is a U S law, but your U S client will make your company sign a contract promising to follow it (you will learn about this B A A in the next lesson).

lines.raw: Breaking it can cost the client, your company and you your job.
lines.say: Breaking it can cost the client, your company and you your job.

lines.raw: Key takeaways.
lines.say: Key takeaways.

lines.raw: HIPAA = Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act, a US federal law from 1996.
lines.say: HIPAA = Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act, a U S federal law from 1996.

lines.raw: Its main rules: Privacy (who may use and share), Security (protecting electronic data), Breach Notification (what to do after a leak).
lines.say: Its main rules: Privacy (who may use and share), Security (protecting electronic data), Breach Notification (what to do after a leak).

lines.raw: HIPAA also created the standard electronic formats, code sets and the provider ID (NPI) that every claim file uses; the Interoperability course teaches the formats.
lines.say: HIPAA also created the standard electronic formats, code sets and the provider I D (N P I) that every claim file uses; the Interoperability course teaches the formats.

lines.raw: HHS's Office for Civil Rights enforces it.
lines.say: HHS's Office for Civil Rights enforces it.

lines.raw: Offshore teams working on US data must follow HIPAA through their contracts.
lines.say: Offshore teams working on U S data must follow HIPAA through their contracts.
